# Frontend

## Design Tokens

Before writing frontend code, find the project's existing tokens file (`tokens.css`, `variables.css`, `theme.ts`, `tailwind.config.*`, `_variables.scss`). If there isn't one, create it. Never hardcode raw values in components.

Cover these token categories: colors (semantic names with dark-mode variants), a spacing scale, border radius, shadows (an elevation system), typography (display, body, and mono fonts, plus a type scale and weights), breakpoints, transitions (durations and easing), and a z-index scale.

## Design Principles

Pick one primary principle; don't mix them at random.

| Principle | When to use |
|---|---|
| **Glassmorphism** | Overlays, modern dashboards |
| **Neumorphism** | Settings panels, minimal controls |
| **Brutalism** | Developer tools, editorial sites |
| **Minimalism** | Portfolios, documentation, content-first |
| **Maximalism** | Creative agencies, e-commerce |
| **Claymorphism** | Playful apps, onboarding |
| **Bento Grid** | Dashboards, feature showcases |
| **Aurora / Mesh Gradients** | Landing pages, hero sections |
| **Flat Design** | Mobile apps, system UI |
| **Material Elevation** | Data-heavy apps, enterprise |
| **Editorial** | Blogs, long-form content |

## Component Framework

Use whatever the project already has, and don't mix competing libraries.

| Category | Options (pick one) |
|---|---|
| CSS | Tailwind, vanilla CSS, CSS Modules, styled-components, Emotion, UnoCSS, Panda CSS |
| Primitives | shadcn/ui, Radix, Headless UI, Ark UI, DaisyUI, Mantine, Chakra, Vuetify |
| Animation | CSS transitions, Framer Motion, GSAP, View Transitions API, AutoAnimate |
| Charts | Recharts, D3, Chart.js, Visx, ECharts, Nivo |
| Icons | Lucide, Phosphor, Heroicons, Tabler Icons, Iconify |

## Layout

- Use CSS Grid for 2D layouts and Flexbox for 1D. Use `gap`, not margin hacks.
- Use semantic HTML: `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<section>`, `<article>`, `<footer>`.
- Design mobile-first. Touch targets are at least 44x44px.

## Accessibility (non-negotiable)

- Make all interactive elements keyboard-accessible.
- Give images meaningful `alt` text; use `alt=""` for decorative ones.
- Pair form inputs with an associated `<label>` or `aria-label`.
- Meet contrast ratios of 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text.
- Keep focus indicators visible. Never use `outline: none` without a replacement.
- Never rely on color as the sole indicator.
- Use `aria-live` for dynamic content. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and `prefers-color-scheme`.

## Performance

- Images: use `loading="lazy"` below the fold, with explicit `width`/`height`.
- Fonts: use `font-display: swap`.
- Animations: animate `transform` and `opacity` only.
- Large lists: virtualize at 100+ items.
- Bundle size: never import a whole library for one function.
